measure_description: Measured on a Shelly Pro 3EM phase (differential: each brightness row between two light-off baselines, row repeated on baseline drift; 2.5 s median per point). Full grid bri 1-251 step 5 plus 255 x mired 153-453 step 10 plus 454; smoothed over neighbouring brightness rows (+-2) and mired (1-2-1), made monotonic in brightness. Standby measured by cutting mains power at the wall switch (4 cycles).
name: Hue Adore Bathroom Mirror
